verbatim: Ultimately, we will be interpreting this work instead of documenting it, so in areas of ambiguity, it is correct to form an opinion, so long it is rational and supported, that can be updated later on rather than leaving threads and missing areas due to lacking information. Do search comprehensively for midi logs and stress test them against interpretation of the youtube clubs
interpretation: YouTube clubs is understood from the established task as YouTube clips.
scope: DKC reference interpretation and MIDI comparison, not approval of runtime replacement or release.
